lore:
They say one of the houses wasn't supposed to exist.

Nobody seems to agree which one. 👀

Apparently, someone saw a professor enter the Room of Requirement after midnight.

They never saw them come back out.

I heard one of the challenges has already started.

We just haven't been told which one.
Someone claims there's something hidden in the house crests that nobody has noticed yet.
Apparently, the obvious answer in one of the trials is deliberately wrong.

I heard the animals aren't just house mascots.

They're supposed to tell us something.
Rumor has it there's a way to earn points that isn't listed in the tournament rules.

Someone supposedly already figured out part of the Maze.

Interesting considering nobody has entered it yet...

And apparently, one champion was originally sorted into an entirely different house.

Nobody seems particularly interested in explaining why. 👀
